children: Piper Sandler reiterated their Overweight rating on 1st Source's stock with a price target of $105.00.
The price target implies an upside of 19.5% from the Oct 26 close of $87.86.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: 1st Source Corp demonstrated impressive financial results with a 2.3% core return on assets (ROA) and 17% return on tangible common equity (ROTCE), driven by a 13% upside in pre-provision net revenue (PPNR) due to increased net interest income (NII) and net interest margin (NIM) expansion, alongside solid loan growth and improved credit metrics.

: The company is projected to continue outperforming its peers, bolstered by expectations of stable NIM and organic balance sheet growth, particularly in differentiated lending verticals, which positions it favorably for sustained profitability and capital generation moving forward.
